results.commentary: The detailed inventory checks reflect the tight memory constraints Briggs faced, where every small object mattered. This technical necessity shaped the narrative pacing, mirroring the pressure to make every word count.
The sequential logic of this puzzle reflects the technical constraints of the era. Every interaction had to be meticulously implemented to fit the game's limited memory.
